text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm all set! Zazen meditation workshop, here I come!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Harmonizing my mind and polishing my presence as a model student… What an ingenious plan I've come up with! I have to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monk
text_block_list.text: Okay, let your eyes slowly close. Concentrate and don't make a sound…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Close my eyes! And be quiet… quiet…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah… I-I feel so tired. So this is zazen…

text_block_list.name: Zazen Trial Participants
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Zazen meditation is incredible! My mind and body feel so much lighter!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: H-how can that be? Does that mean… I… I didn't do it right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her mood worsens as she's confronted with her own lack of experience.
